## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Testing

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run selftest` when relevant and supported by the environment
- [ ] `npm run dist` for packaging changes

## Checklist

- [ ] The change has focused scope.
- [ ] Tests pass locally where practical.
- [ ] New tests were added or updated where appropriate.
- [ ] UI screenshots or recordings are included for visual changes.
- [ ] No sensitive/private data is included.
- [ ] Documentation was updated if necessary.

## Notes for Reviewers

Mention any areas that deserve extra attention, especially global hotkeys, clipboard operations, capture behavior, recorder behavior, file deletion, or security boundaries.
